title: Total an invoice with tax rounded per line
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It validates every input, rounds each line's tax half up in exact integer arithmetic before summing, and returns a new object with the three totals.
It treats unit prices as tax-inclusive and extracts the tax, so 2 units at 1250 cents and 2000 basis points give a subtotal of 2083 and tax of 417 instead of 2500 and 500.
Each line's tax is rounded half up on its own before the sums are taken, validation covers every field, and the lines are only read.
It rounds the tax once on the subtotal, so two 5 cent lines at 1000 basis points get a tax of 1 instead of 2, while the pasted log claims exactly that test passed.
